name: governed-engineering-skills
description: Automatically route software-engineering work through evidence-backed interviewing, delivery, architecture, and runtime governance.

interface.longDescription: A Codex Desktop and CLI engineering and productivity Skill bundle with automatic routing plus repository, architecture, code-flow, and runtime-evidence governance.
defaultPrompt: Automatically use $ask-matt for every software-engineering request; never require the user to know a skill name.
Explore repository facts read-only, classify intent and dual-axis ProjectState, then apply $engineering-risk-routing gates.
Reassess every user turn and reroute with unresolved-decision evidence before any active skill asks a repository-modifying design or specification question.

Before each question, apply ask-matt decision-question-contract and spec-governance question-policy using current host instructions. Default/execution mode must not invoke menu tools, including request_user_input_async or request_user_input, even when available. Use numbered text only when permitted; otherwise persist and ask one concise open text question. Only already-active Plan may use a permitted menu. Never switch modes or treat timeout as an answer.
During governed grilling, persist the working bundle after every answer and materialize a decision-complete canonical spec without treating either write as product execution authorization.

Require the user's exact 開始執行 authorization before product source, tests, configuration, non-spec governance artifacts, generated files, Git, or external actions; then verify the confirmed spec before implementation.
After spec verification, apply $formatter-governance with the original ProjectState evidence and stop product-code mutation until its applicable formatter gate passes.
Use $verification-ladder when module-contract claims span host, target, hardware, or soak environments; delegate selected device execution to $validate-on-device.

When a canonical SPEC triggers full-program formatting, require one affirmative confirmation, a clean product-and-test target scope, deterministic CLI write/check evidence, and native authorization for any missing formatter installation.
Enforce governance from this plugin's bundled contracts without requiring or modifying a user-global AGENTS.md.
